lines: Fine. I have enough problems without carrying this one too.
Fine. I will set this down before it gets heavier.
Alright. Step back and let us end this here.
You admitted the damage. That matters to me.
The full repair is enough. We can stop fighting now.
Keep your hands down and I will do the same.
That sounds like an honest apology at last.
I would rather walk away than keep feeding this anger.
We both get to leave safely. That is worth choosing.
I am still upset, but I am listening.
Take the peace and leave the quarrel here.
I accept the repair. Do not make me ask twice.
We can settle this without another person getting hurt.
I believe you mean it this time.
The anger is easing. Give it room to go.
I will remember that you tried to make this right.
No more threats. No more excuses. We are done.
This does not erase what happened, but it can end it.
I am lowering my hands. Follow my lead.
We have an agreement. Let us keep it.
Even without a trade, I know that should be {emerald_cost} {emeralds}.
That is short of the full repair. Bring {emerald_cost} {emeralds}.
Not enough. It takes {emerald_cost} {emeralds} to settle this.
Count it again. The full amount is not there.
You cannot call half a payment a full apology.
The offer does not cover the harm you caused.
Bring the rest and then we can talk about peace.
I am not haggling over what we already agreed.
A handful of emeralds does not settle this.
You still owe part of the repair.
Do not rush me because you came unprepared.
Peace costs the full agreed amount.
I will wait for the proper payment.
That offer is close, but close is still short.
You knew the cost before you came here.
I want the full repair, not a promise about the rest.
Come back when you can finish what you started.
The missing emeralds matter because the damage was real.
I am willing to settle this, but not for less than we agreed.
Bring {emerald_cost} {emeralds} and we can end it cleanly.
No. I may not have work, but I still have sense.
No. Some damage has to cool before payment matters.
No. Keep {payment_items}. Trust is not ready to trade.
Step away. I am not ready to bargain with you.
You cannot buy your way closer while I still feel threatened.
The offer can wait until everyone is safe.
Put the payment down and back away.
I do not trust your hands enough to make a deal.
This is too fresh for emeralds to fix.
I need distance more than I need payment right now.
Do not mistake my silence for an invitation to negotiate.
We can discuss repair later. Not while you are standing that close.
Keep the items. I will not accept them under pressure.
I am too angry to promise peace honestly.
Come back when the threat is gone and the village has had time to breathe.
Payment offered before safety is not peace.
I cannot accept a settlement while I am still afraid of you.
Leave now. We can decide what is owed later.
Some harm needs time before anyone names a price.
This conversation is over until I say otherwise.
